objectives: Derive and implement a numerically stable log-sum-exp reduction
Reason about floating-point overflow and translation invariance
title: Stable log-sum-exp
shortDescription: Compute a log-partition term without overflowing exponentials.
statement:
Read an integer n followed by n real values from stdin. Print log(sum(exp(x_i))) using natural logarithms. Your program must remain stable for large positive or negative logits. Print a single finite number; absolute or relative error up to 1e-9 is accepted.

Example input: `2 0 0`. The result is approximately `0.6931471805599453`.
constraints: 1 <= n <= 64; each logit is finite and in [-1000, 1000]. Values are whitespace separated. Use double precision. No empty input cases are graded.
explanation: Let m=max(x). Then log(sum(exp(x_i))) = m + log(sum(exp(x_i-m))). Every exponent is nonpositive, so no term overflows. At least one exponential equals 1, avoiding an all-zero sum. The independent verifier uses high-precision Decimal arithmetic without the maximum-shift transformation.
reviewNotes: Anchor values follow analytically: one logit is unchanged; two zeros give ln(2); equal logits give x+ln(n). The independent Decimal implementation uses 60 digits and direct exponentials. Mutants omit the logarithm or normalize by n. Generated inputs include +/-1000 and narrow/large spreads.

references.source:
import sys, math
a=list(map(float,sys.stdin.read().split()))
x=a[1:]
m=max(x)
print(m+math.log(math.fsum(math.exp(v-m) for v in x)))

use std::io::{self, Read};
fn main(){let mut s=String::new();io::stdin().read_to_string(&mut s).unwrap();let mut it=s.split_whitespace();let n:usize=it.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();let x:Vec<f64>=it.take(n).map(|v|v.parse().unwrap()).collect();let m=x.iter().copied().fold(f64::NEG_INFINITY,f64::max);let z:f64=x.iter().map(|v|(v-m).exp()).sum();println!("{:.16}",m+z.ln());}

import sys
from decimal import Decimal, localcontext
v=sys.stdin.read().split()[1:]
with localcontext() as ctx:
    ctx.prec=60
    print(sum((Decimal(x).exp() for x in v),Decimal(0)).ln())
